note: Sites from Catalina master list with no published GPS — not placed on pin-trust map. No invented coordinates.
wgs84: All master-list GPS pins are franko_* review candidates. Reference only — not for navigation.

relativeNoGps.name: West Bathtub (Juicy Reef)
relativeNoGps.description: 15'-40' Rocky with lots of kelp. Calicos, yellowtail & shovelnose guitarfish.

relativeNoGps.name: Bathtub Cove (Juicy Reef)
relativeNoGps.description: 15'-45' Excellent kelp bed with lobsters & calico bass. Great viz.

relativeNoGps.name: Jake's Beach
relativeNoGps.description: 0'-30' Cobblestone beach entry or great kayak-in snorkeling in rich kelp patch.

relativeNoGps.name: Pedestal Rock
relativeNoGps.description: 15'-100' A cone at 90' depth on south side. Good for all levels. Lobsters, pelagic gamefish.

relativeNoGps.name: Big Fisherman's Cove
relativeNoGps.source: Near Blue Cavern Point (no independent GPS in master)
relativeNoGps.description: 0'-85' Marine Refuge with great snorkeling from Little Fisherman’s Cove. Restricted rocks & caves along shore.

relativeNoGps.name: Catalina Harbor & Well's Beach
relativeNoGps.description: 0'-40' 99 Moorings, & anchorage for up to 200. Poor visibility. Scant remnants of 200-year-old Chinese pirate ship near Ballast Point. 14 sea miles from Isthmus Cove.
